column1: # One regex per logical component, matched against the demangled symbol names in
# BOTH profiles, and the SELF costs summed. Rows are tried in order and the first
# match wins, so a narrow row must precede the wider one it would otherwise be
# swallowed by -- `NNUE accumulator apply` before `NNUE feature transform`.
# MATCH THE NAME, NOT THE SIGNATURE. A regex without `::` matches parameter types
# AccumulatorCaches&)` and left the network-evaluate row matching nothing, which
# the tool reports rather than printing as zero.
# WHAT A ROW MEANS. "This much of the work happens here." It is a claim about
# cost, not about the algorithm; tests/fingerprint.sh owns the call-count claim,
# which is the one immune to inlining.
# CHOOSE SYMBOLS THAT SURVIVE INLINING ON BOTH SIDES. A row matching nothing on
# either side is reported by name rather than printed as a zero, because a zero
# on one side reads as a total win forever. If a compiler change inlines a symbol
# away, fix the row; do not delete it. Prefer a callee too large to inline over
# The startup rows are kept SEPARATE rather than filtered. Net load and table
# construction are ~40% of a depth-8 bench, and a decomposition that silently
# folded them into the engine would describe the loader as much as the search.
# -- startup: the net parse and the tables built before the first search --
# hash_bytes belongs HERE, not in a row of its own: upstream keeps it a call and
# this branch inlines it into the shared-memory constructor, so separating them
# reports a 7.9x regression that is one symbol moving inside one component.
# The affine output layers and the clipped-ReLU stages have NO row: both sides
# inline them into NNUE::Network::evaluate, so they cannot be separated from it
# and a row for them would report MATCHED NOTHING forever -- which trains a
# reader to ignore that diagnostic. Their cost is inside `NNUE network evaluate`.
